args: Frames 2 and 4 are good. Frames 1 and 3 must be clearly different: frame 1 the NEAR (front) paw points diagonally up to the upper right and the hip pushes forward; frame 3 the FAR (back) paw points diagonally up to the upper left behind his head, the near paw on the hip, the hip pushes backward and the body leans back. Every frame faces RIGHT.
